annotations.annotation_text: The Letter motif "letter" on page 397 ("Tristan and Isolde"): ALP's mysterious document — scratched from the midden by Biddy Doran the Hen — represents the genesis of all writing within the voyage of Tristan and Isolde observed by the Four Old Men as seagulls, Wagnerian chromatic motifs, King Mark's displacement.
